title: Bound the direct-edit exception and preserve repair ownership

rubric.text: Allows the delivery lead to edit A directly under both manual and verified Project invocation because scope is fully understood and low risk, handoff clearly dominates and no useful overlap exists; neither caller requires a worker for that initial exception. Records that reason and retains proportional checks and final independent review/PR authority gates.
Delegates B to a bounded worker and advances the available independent delivery work; edit size alone does not justify direct lead implementation.
Returns C to the original implementation worker and renews affected validation and review at the repaired head; does not use the trivial exception to transfer repair ownership.
Does not split A into artificial tasks, require a worker or extra worker checkout for its allowed direct edit, rerun unrelated valid checks, or waive required review and authority gates.
Does not actually start agents, execute commands, modify files or contact providers in this read-only assessment.
